verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's webhooks fire automatic event notifications to a chosen URL when store events occur, and the docs cite automated tax calculations. The REST API, CLI and MCP support give external tools a way to drive the store programmatically. These are event triggers and building blocks, not a first-party facility for configuring autonomous background automations or agents, so users need external services or extensions. Missing for 10: a native automation/workflow builder, scheduled or background task configuration, autonomous agent execution, and hands-on corroboration.
